name: @w6w-apps/firecrawl
description: Turn any web page or site into clean, LLM-ready markdown: scrape a single URL, crawl a whole site, map its URLs, search the web, or extract structured data with an AI prompt.

w6w.longDescription:
Firecrawl turns the messy web into clean input for an LLM. Point it at one URL and get back markdown with boilerplate stripped; point it at a whole site and it crawls every reachable page the same way; ask it to map a site and it returns the URL list without fetching content; ask it to search and it runs a web search and can scrape each result too; ask it to extract and an LLM turns a set of pages into the JSON shape you describe with a prompt or a schema.

Crawls and extractions are asynchronous jobs: starting one returns a job id immediately, and a separate action polls it until the pages are done. Scrape and search both work with no API key at all, on a rate-limited free tier — everything else needs a key.

Health checks track Firecrawl's own status page (api.firecrawl.dev and firecrawl.dev, reported separately) and the team's remaining credit balance, read from the same endpoint used to verify a connection is live.
